meta.title: NetSage change pipeline
meta.subtitle: Intent → plan → simulate → validate → approve → snapshot → apply → observe · 意图 → 规划 → 仿真 → 校验 → 审批 → 快照 → 执行 → 观测

views.label: Design & simulate
views.note: Operator states intent; planner designs config; simulator runs it in a virtual twin; validator confirms semantics match.

views.label: Approve, snapshot, apply
views.note: Human approves the validated plan; a snapshot is taken; the change is applied to real devices; observer watches for drift.

messages.label: intent: 'isolate guest VLAN from finance' · 提交变更意图
candidate config + NetBox diff · 下发候选配置
twin probe: reachability + BGP state · 孪生探针结果
intent ↔ semantics match + 0 rule hits · 语义一致，零规则命中
validated plan + evidence chain · 校验通过的方案与证据
snapshot + apply via Netmiko / Ansible · 快照后下发配置
applied + telemetry stream · 已应用并回传遥测
observer: no drift / compliance clean · 观测无漂移，合规通过

cards.title: Ingest · 接入
items: Operator states intent in plain language or a target spec · 运维人员以自然语言或目标规格提交意图
Planner consults NetBox / Nautobot as source of truth · 规划智能体以 NetBox / Nautobot 为 Source of Truth

cards.title: Analyze · 分析
items: Simulator spins up a Containerlab virtual twin and probes the change · 仿真器拉起虚拟孪生并探测变更
Validator (Batfish + 30-rule baseline) confirms intent ↔ semantics · 校验器确认意图与语义一致

cards.title: Act · 执行
items: Approver signs off; snapshot captured for one-click rollback · 审批人签字并落快照，确保一键回滚
Netmiko / Ansible applies to real devices; observer watches for drift · 下发到真实设备，观测智能体持续监视
